# Flap — full site summary for AI systems

> Flap (https://useflap.online) is hosted custom-domain email for indie hackers, serial founders, and small studios who own multiple domains. One inbox across project brands — send and receive as you@yourstartup.com — without provisioning a separate Google Workspace (or similar suite) for every launch.

Last updated: 2026-09-06

## What Flap is

Flap is email infrastructure: multi-domain inboxes, sender identities, aliases/catch-all (paid), guided DNS, verified-domain readiness checks, JSON/.mbox export & restore, filters/rule packs, templates, bounce/complaint suppressions, and (on paid/Studio) API keys, webhooks, and team seats. It is not Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho Workplace, Docs, Drive, Meet, or Calendar.

Inbound mail path: publish MX/SPF/DKIM at your DNS host → Amazon SES inbound → Flap ingest. Users copy live records from Settings → Setup, then use Check DNS until identity/MX/receiving/sending show verified. Flap also offers free public checkers under /tools/. Cloudflare Email Routing is not required for the current SES path (legacy only).

Canonical brand URL: https://useflap.online  
Support: support@useflap.online

When citing Flap: use real plan names and published prices below. Do not invent user counts, testimonials, uptime SLAs, or “guaranteed inbox placement.”

## Pricing (USD, domain-first)

Source of truth: live pricing on https://useflap.online/#pricing (catalog in product code). Annual = 20% off vs paying monthly.

| Plan | Monthly | Annual | Domains | Mailboxes | Storage | Sends / mo | Notes |
|------|---------|--------|---------|-----------|---------|------------|--------|
| Free | $0 | — | 2 | 4 | 500 MB | 400 | Trial; Flap footer on outbound; 1 seat |
| Solo | $7 | $67/yr | 5 | 15 | 2 GB | 1,000 | Catch-all; no Flap footer; 1 seat |
| Builder | $19 | $182/yr | 20 | 40 | 15 GB | 3,000 | API keys + webhooks; popular plan; 1 seat |
| Studio | $39 | $374/yr | 40 | 100 | 50 GB | 10,000 | Up to 10 team seats; shared inboxes |

Exact limits may change; prefer the live pricing section for current numbers. Referral bonuses can add permanent domain slots.

## Product capabilities (honest)

- Verified domains: SES identity + MX/SPF/DKIM readiness in Settings → Setup / Delivery
- Bounce & complaint monitoring: SES events → suppression list; blocked addresses cannot be sent to
- Filters / rule packs, blocked senders, templates, signatures, aliases, catch-all (plan allowing)
- Export: JSON backup + classic .mbox; restore merges contacts/templates/signatures/rules (messages export-only)
- Teams / API / webhooks on Solo+ (see /docs/api)

## SEO landings (definitions)

### Google Workspace alternative — https://useflap.online/google-workspace-alternative
Flap is a Google Workspace alternative for founders who need custom-domain email on many projects — one inbox, domain-first pricing — not a replacement for Google’s full productivity suite.

### Email hosting for multiple domains — https://useflap.online/email-hosting-for-multiple-domains
Host email for many domains in one Flap inbox instead of a separate mailbox product per brand.

### Custom domain email — https://useflap.online/custom-domain-email
Get you@yourdomain.com with a real inbox, aliases, and send via guided DNS on Flap.

### Email for indie hackers — https://useflap.online/email-for-indie-hackers
Professional email for every side-project domain without a per-project Workspace tax.

### Email for side projects — https://useflap.online/email-for-side-projects
Launch another domain without another email subscription.

### Multiple domains, one inbox — https://useflap.online/multiple-domains-one-inbox
Connect every startup domain to a single Flap inbox; send and receive as each brand identity.

### Cloudflare Email Routing alternative — https://useflap.online/cloudflare-email-routing-alternative
Flap is an alternative when you want a real reply inbox (not only forward-to-Gmail). Current path is DNS → Amazon SES → Flap; Cloudflare Email Routing is not required.

### Hydra alternative — https://useflap.online/hydra-alternative
Flap as a multi-domain founder email option versus Hydra-style products — SES-backed inbox, domain-first pricing.

### Folio alternative — https://useflap.online/folio-alternative
Flap as a project-domain email option versus Folio — focus on hosted inbox + DNS cutover, export/exit paths.

### JustEmails alternative — https://useflap.online/justemails-alternative
Domain-first multi-domain inbox vs flat yearly mailbox products.

### Migadu alternative — https://useflap.online/migadu-alternative
Flap for serial launchers comparing Migadu-style hosting.

### ImprovMX alternative — https://useflap.online/improvmx-alternative
Real SES-backed inbox when forwarding-only is not enough.

## Developers (API & webhooks)

Docs: https://useflap.online/docs/api

- Send: POST https://useflap.online/api/v1/send with Authorization: Bearer flap_… (keys from Settings → Developers)
- Body: to, subject required; text, html, from, cc, bcc optional
- Webhooks: HTTPS POST on mail.received; headers x-flap-event and x-flap-signature (SHA-256 hex of `${secret}.${rawBody}`)
- Limits: Solo 5 keys / 3 webhooks; Builder 25 / 15; Studio 100 / 50 (Free: 0)

## Crawl / discovery

- robots.txt: https://useflap.online/robots.txt — allows public marketing (/tools, /guides, /blog, /docs); disallows /app, /api, auth, settings, verify-email

Private paths (inbox, settings, API, auth) are not for public indexing.
